about_body_1: Advanced Analytical Junction is a professional open-source intelligence and footprinting tool designed to be easy to use, fast, and extensible.
about_body_2: For support, bug reports, or feature requests, contact your internal system administrator.
please_go_back: Please go back and try again. If you believe this is an error, please contact your system administrator.
scan_target_help: Specify the domain name, IP address, hostname, network range, or email address.
name: Name
usecase_all_desc: All modules will be enabled (slow) but every possible piece of information about the target will be obtained and analysed.
usecase_footprint_desc: Gain an understanding about the target's network perimeter, associated identities and other information that is obtained through a lot of web crawling and search engine use.
usecase_investigate_desc: Some basic footprinting will be performed in addition to querying of blacklists and other sources that may have information about your target's maliciousness.
usecase_passive_desc: As much information will be gathered without touching the target or their affiliates, therefore only modules that do not touch the target will be enabled.
_maxthreads: Max number of modules to run concurrently
_useragent: User-Agent string to use for HTTP requests
_dnsserver: Override the default resolver with another DNS server
_fetchtimeout: Number of seconds before giving up on a HTTP request.
_internettlds_cache: Hours to cache the Internet TLD list.
_genericusers: List of usernames that if found as usernames or as part of e-mail addresses, should be treated differently to non-generics.
_socks1type: SOCKS Server Type. Can be '4', '5', 'HTTP' or 'TOR'
no_results_found: No results found. Try broadening your search criteria.
insufficient_data: Insufficient data to produce a graph.
scan_running_update: If the scan is still running this section will update shortly.
scan_running_try_again: If the scan is still running please try again soon.
no_correlations_help: If the scan is still running please reload once it has completed.
target_help_col1:
Domain Name: e.g. example.com
IPv4 Address: e.g. 1.2.3.4
IPv6 Address: e.g. 2606:4700:4700::1111
Hostname/Sub-domain: e.g. abc.example.com
Subnet: e.g. 1.2.3.0/24
Bitcoin Address: e.g. 1HesYJSP1QqcyPEjnQ9vzBL1wujruNGe7R
target_help_col2:
E-mail address: e.g. bob@example.com
Phone Number: e.g. +12345678901 (E.164 format)
Human Name: e.g. "John Smith" (must be in quotes)
Username: e.g. "jsmith2000" (must be in quotes)
Network ASN: e.g. 1234
